verdict.rationale: Mercury's API covers transactions, categories, statements, merchants, treasury reads, and a full Accounts Receivable (invoices/customers) surface, plus OAuth2 for programmatic access—substantial parity for AR and reporting. However, the documented endpoint catalog omits core UI capabilities like creating/managing virtual cards, initiating payments/wires, bill pay AI automation, and spend controls, so full UI-to-API parity is not evidenced.
